title: LARC multicellular response programs: revision code and aggregate source data
description: Versioned reproducibility code and aggregate results for manuscript CBAC-D-26-05807. Raw third-party matrices and CNP patient/sample/cell derivatives are excluded; obtain source data through CNGBdb/GEO. Patient response units and descriptive four-section evidence are distinguished.
